reviews.body:
Nice follow-up to #1916, @pcbeingused333, HuggingFace was the one backend still sending `MaxLength: 0`.

The change reads right: `maxTokensOrDefault` returns `maxToken` (2048) when nothing is set, the existing 500 cap still applies, and `TestHuggingface_DefaultMaxTokensWhenUnset` covers it. Build, lint and codecov are green.

One thing to fix: `validate` fails on the title, because `deps` is the only allowed scope. Rename it to something like `fix: default maxtokens in the huggingface backend when unset` and this is ready.

Thanks for amending the commit, @pcbeingused333, `validate` is green now.

Checked the new head `371381b` against the `d856a50` I reviewed: `pkg/ai/huggingface.go` and `pkg/ai/maxtokens_default_test.go` are byte-identical (same blob hashes), only the commit message changed. So the earlier read holds: an unset `maxtokens` now falls back through `maxTokensOrDefault` and hits the existing 500 cap instead of sending `MaxLength: 0`, and `TestHuggingface_DefaultMaxTokensWhenUnset` pins it.

Build, lint, tests, codecov, DCO, EasyCLA and `validate` all pass at this head. Good to merge
